title: Copilot agent workflow shell step: rely on defaults.run.shell bash for fail-fast, not on set -euo pipefail
answers: Why did the Copilot agent print 'No linked issues' even though the GitHub API call failed?
Do I need to add set -e to the copilot-agent workflow run steps?
How do failed GraphQL or jq calls surface in the copilot-agent workflow?
body:
Path: Run steps in .github/workflows/copilot-agent.yml that fetch linked issues with gh api graphql and parse them with jq before posting comments. Inputs are the PR number, owner and repo from github context; the output feeds the for-loop that calls gh issue comment. Chokepoint: .github/workflows/copilot-agent.yml:defaults (run.shell: bash).
Rule: Because the workflow sets defaults.run.shell to bash, GitHub Actions runs the script with -e -o pipefail, so a failed command substitution (`response=$(gh api ...)`) or a failing jq pipeline fails the step. Do not add a redundant `set -euo pipefail` to these run blocks; check that defaults.run.shell is still bash if you change the step's shell.
Symptom: A transient GraphQL error could leave the issue list empty, so the step printed 'No linked issues.' and skipped notifications silently. Reviewers flagged this as a possible silent failure; the defaults setting already makes the step fail, so the fix is to keep the shell default, not to add error handling.
Constraints: Applies only while the step uses the workflow default shell. A step that overrides shell (for example to sh) loses -e and pipefail and needs its own set -euo pipefail.
applies: Applies to run steps in .github/workflows/copilot-agent.yml that use the workflow default shell.
says: The bot claimed there were no linked issues when the search actually failed.
Why did the bot skip issue notifications without showing an error when lookups failed?
Ensure failed lookups stop the process instead of silently reporting zero linked issues.
Make sure temporary service outages cause the issue linking step to fail visibly.
search: Run steps fetching linked issues in .github/workflows/copilot-agent.yml rely on defaults.run.shell bash to enforce fail-fast behavior on failed gh api graphql calls or jq pipelines rather than explicit set -euo pipefail. Targets the run step executing response=$(gh api ...) and gh issue comment within .github/workflows/copilot-agent.yml:defaults. Applies only when using the workflow default bash shell; any step overriding shell to sh loses -e and pipefail and requires explicit set -euo pipefail.
